```{r}
player_df <- read.csv("C:/Users/matth/Downloads/womens_aggregated_session.csv")
sessions_df <- read.csv("C:/Users/matth/Downloads/womens_soccer_select.csv")
```

```{r}
player_df$athlete_relative_age <- as.factor(player_df$athlete_relative_age)
sessions_df$athlete_relative_age <- as.factor(sessions_df$athlete_relative_age)
```

```{r}
ggplot(player_df, aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = w_max_speed_kph, fill = athlete_relative_age)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Max Speed by Relative Age (Player Aggregated)",
       x = "Relative Age",
       y = "Max Speed (kph)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
### CLEAN BOXPLOTS FOR TOTAL DISTANCE

# --- Create summary dataframe ---
summary_df <- player_df %>%
  group_by(athlete_relative_age) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1 = quantile(w_total_distance, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(w_total_distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(w_total_distance, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x_pos = as.numeric(factor(athlete_relative_age))
  )

# --- Overall median for reference line ---
overall_median <- median(player_df$w_total_distance, na.rm = TRUE)

# --- Plot ---
ggplot(player_df, aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = w_total_distance)) +
  
  # Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#4E79A7", width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  # Overall median reference line
  geom_hline(yintercept = overall_median, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  
  # --- Labels ---
  # Q1 (left)
  geom_text(data = summary_df,
            aes(x = x_pos - 0.35, y = Q1, label = round(Q1, 0)),
            size = 4, hjust = 1) +
  
  # Median (centered, emphasized)
  geom_text(data = summary_df,
            aes(x = x_pos, y = Median, label = round(Median, 0)),
            size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", vjust = -0.5) +
  
  # Q3 (left)
  geom_text(data = summary_df,
            aes(x = x_pos - 0.35, y = Q3, label = round(Q3, 0)),
            size = 4, hjust = 1) +
  
  # Labels & theme
  labs(
    title = "Total Distance by Relative Age",
    subtitle = "Quartiles and median shown; dashed line = overall median",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Total Distance (meters)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
### CREATING CLEAN BOXPLOT OF SESSION LOAD WITH QUARTILE LABELS FOR PRESENTATION
```

```{r}
plot_player_highlight <- function(player_id, metric, y_label) {
  
  highlight_df <- player_df %>%
    filter(athlete_number == player_id)
  
  ggplot(player_df, aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = .data[[metric]])) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgray", alpha = 0.7) +
    
    geom_point(data = highlight_df,
               aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = .data[[metric]]),
               color = "red", size = 4) +
    
    labs(title = paste(y_label, "- Athlete", player_id),
         x = "Relative Age",
         y = y_label) +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_player_highlight(1018, "w_max_speed_kph", "Max Speed (kph)")
plot_player_highlight(1018, "w_total_distance", "Total Distance")
plot_player_highlight(1018, "w_session_load", "Session Load")
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility (optional)

random_session <- sessions_df %>%
  sample_n(1)

random_session
player_id <- random_session$athlete_number
player_age <- random_session$athlete_relative_age
player_speed <- random_session$max_speed_kph
player_percentile <- random_session$max_speed_perc_rank

ggplot(sessions_df, aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = max_speed_kph)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgray", alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # highlight THIS session
  geom_point(data = random_session,
             aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = max_speed_kph),
             color = "red", size = 4) +
  
  geom_text(data = random_session,
            aes(label = paste0("P", round(max_speed_perc_rank))),
            vjust = -1.2,
            color = "red") +
  
  labs(
    title = paste("Session Max Speed Benchmark - Athlete", player_id),
    subtitle = paste("Max Speed:", round(player_speed, 2), "kph | Percentile:", round(player_percentile), "%"),
    x = "Relative Age",
    y = "Max Speed (kph)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
```
